Vanika Aaranya Set

MOQ: 15 pcs
Enquire on WhatsApp

Rooted in tribal artistry and elevated with intricate detailing, this statement set from the Vanika Collection celebrates raw beauty with refined strength. Layered metal chains, antique-finish motifs, and textured bead clusters come together to create a bold yet balanced silhouette. Accented with earthy green stones, soft pearls, and ghungroo-inspired elements, this set feels like a modern heirloom, powerful, expressive, and unmistakably striking. Designed for those who appreciate jewellery with character, it pairs beautifully with handloom saris, festive lehengas, and contemporary fusion wear.
